body_html:
This 14-piece all-sponge modular kids play couch is constructed with integrated non-detachable corduroy outer fabric and high-density foam interior. Featuring 14 independent modules that support unlimited free splicing and rearrangement, it can be assembled into a standard two-seat sofa, play fort, rest lounge, small bed, game structure and various creative shapes to inspire children's imagination. Without removable zipper covers, the integrated fabric wrapping effectively prevents slipping and deformation during frequent disassembly and play. The fully assembled sofa overall dimension is 55.12" L × 23.62" D × 15.75" H, perfectly suited for kids' daily reading, napping and indoor pretend play in bedrooms, play areas and living rooms.

Bullet Point 1: 14-Piece Independent Module Free Combination Structure

This kids play couch comes with 14 separate foam modules that can be taken apart and reassembled arbitrarily without fixed installation steps. Children can DIY countless play scenes including play tents, slide tracks, casual sofas and temporary rest beds, effectively exercising hands-on ability and spatial thinking while satisfying diverse indoor play and relaxation needs.

Bullet Point 2: Entire Item Filled With Premium High Resilience Full Sponge

The whole play sofa adopts one-piece high-density elastic sponge as inner filling, no hard wood or metal frames inside. It maintains proper softness for sitting and lying, and resists collapsing and long-term compression deformation. All module edges are polished into smooth arcs to avoid bumps and scratches, offering safe use for toddlers and young kids.

Bullet Point 3: Integrated Non-Detachable Corduroy Fabric Surface

The outer corduroy cover is tightly sewn and fixed onto each foam module, cannot be unzipped or detached. This integrated design avoids the trouble of loose fabric cover during frequent disassembly and assembly. The thick corduroy material is wear-resistant, breathable and gentle on kids' sensitive skin; simply wipe the surface with a damp cloth for daily stain cleaning.

Bullet Point 4: Clear Standard Inch Dimensions for Whole Sofa & Each Module

Overall size when assembled as a standard sofa: 55.12" Length × 23.62" Depth × 15.75" Height. Every individual component has standardized inch measurements, making it easy to sort, store and restack the blocks after play, no extra measuring required for layout and storage arrangement.

Bullet Point 5: Multi-Scenario Versatile Kids Indoor Furniture

It works as a regular double-seat kids sofa for watching cartoons and story reading, can be rearranged into a nap lounger for daytime rest, and rebuilt into imaginative play structures for role-play games. Ideal placement in kid bedrooms, playrooms, living room corners, kindergartens and nurseries, serving as a thoughtful all-in-one gift for little boys and girls.
